status: V1 physics-constrained seed; electronic values are NOT ATLAS-calibrated until results/ say so

composition.definition: NOT DETERMINED FROM AVAILABLE DATA: the target paper states "IWO (~2% W)" without specifying atomic %, cation %, mol% WO3 or target composition; treated as a material label, never converted to a donor density.

temperature_K.label: ASSUMED
temperature_K.note: measurement temperature not recorded in workbook

chi_bulk_eV.label: LITERATURE_IWO
chi_bulk_eV.consistency_check: bulk In2O3 CNL ~0.4 eV above Ec (Si2021/Lin2022/Wang2022); thin-film Ec rises by dEc(t) so TNL appears deeper below Ec -> EF farther below Ec -> n_FB down, Vth up

mstar_bulk_m0.label: MEASURED_RELATED_MATERIAL
mstar_bulk_m0.source: Stokey2021_JAP optical Hall (pure In2O3 crystal); W-doping increases m* (Januar2026 PBE, qualitative) -> NOT DETERMINED numerically

eps_r.label: MEASURED_TARGET_DEVICE
eps_r.source: Januar2026 SI Fig.S1 (C-V, IWO 9.30+/-0.04; not bundled, recorded by Astra)

Nv300_cm3.label: ASSUMED
Nv300_cm3.note: holes are not solved (electrons-only DD); enters only ni

srh_tau_s.label: ASSUMED
srh_tau_s.note: background SRH, negligible in n-type wide gap

dEg_QC_eV.label: DFT_PURE_IN2O3_PROXY
dEg_QC_eV.note: PBE absolute gaps are NOT used; only slab-minus-bulk shifts. Pure In2O3 proxy for IWO; H-passivated/Al2O3-terminated slabs vs air/Al2O3 in device. Uncertainty ~ +/-50 %.

band_edge_partition.label: DFT_PURE_IN2O3_PROXY
band_edge_partition.source: Si2021: Ec moves up, Ev almost unchanged

Nc300_cm3.label: CALCULATED
Nc300_cm3.note: 3-D parabolic continuum DOS; at 2 nm the film is quasi-2D, so Nc is an effective continuum parameter

Nt_cm3.label: FITTED (anchor from real-ATLAS 2 nm fit: NTA*WTA) consistent with LITERATURE_IWO trend (Januar: ~4x from 13.2 to 2 nm; 5.3e19 at 2 nm with theta_t convention)

WTA_eV.label: FITTED, shared across thickness
WTA_eV.note: Januar2026 reports only dTt under stress; absolute Tt NOT DETERMINED FROM AVAILABLE DATA

thickness_laws.NTA_cm3_eV: Nt(t)/WTA  (gTA(E)=NTA*exp((E-Ec)/WTA); integral over the gap = NTA*WTA*(1-exp(-Eg/WTA)) ~ NTA*WTA)

Nd_eff_cm3.label: FITTED law (effective electrically active background donor density, NOT W concentration)
Nd_eff_cm3.support: Kim2024 (different IWO process): bulk/border trap density 2.4/3.1/14.6e18 at 10/20/30 nm; Januar2026: EF0 deeper for thinner films

mu0_cm2Vs.label: FITTED per thickness (no defensible law; sigmoidal trend attributed to percolation/crystallinity, hypothesis)
mu0_cm2Vs.gate_dependence: NOT inserted natively: ATLAS 5.28.1.R ignores MOBILITY updates between SOLVEs (Claude run_0008); the free/trapped partition of Eq.(5) is produced self-consistently by the DOS occupancy; the Ando roll-off theta_r*Vov is an approximation gap (see LIMITATIONS)

bulk_acceptor_tail.atlas: DEFECTS NTA WTA (cm^-3/eV, eV), acceptor-like, referenced to Ec

bulk_deep_acceptor_gaussian.label: ASSUMED (insensitive; Fan2021 range 2.5-3.7e16 for a different device)

bulk_donor_tail.label: ASSUMED zero (valence tail has negligible effect on n-type transfer curves; Fan2021)

shallow_donor_gaussian.label: ASSUMED zero in V1: the effective donor background is represented by Nd_eff(t); a donor Gaussian at fixed absolute energy (EGD referenced to Ev) is the V2 candidate to replace Nd_eff(t) by the confinement mechanism

interface_acceptor_sheet.label: ASSUMED, shared across thickness; literature Dit(HfO2/In2O3) ~6e11 cm^-2/eV (LITERATURE_IN2O3_PROXY; here IWO/Al2O3)
interface_acceptor_sheet.implementation: regularized 0.25 nm IWO layer at the Al2O3 interface: volume amplitude = sheet peak / 0.25 nm (numerically verified: layer /2 changes Id by 0.009 dec)

fixed_interface_charge_Qf_cm2.label: FITTED single shared value (stage 3); classified as effective electrostatic correction

back_surface_donor_sheet.label: HYPOTHESIS, 31.8 nm only when non-zero (device-specific, stage 6): donor-like states at the free IWO back surface, regularized in a 0.25 nm layer (region 5). Zero for the thin films. Not identifiable separately from Nd and Qf with one transfer curve (V0 evidence: needed to reproduce the flat always-on baseline).

gate_workfunction_eV.label: ASSUMED (TiN 4.5-4.9 eV literature range); degenerate with Qf and chi -> held fixed

source_drain.label: ASSUMED; underconstrained (no TLM); CNL above Ec in In2O3 supports low-barrier contacts (Si2021/Lin2022)

series_resistance_ohm_um.label: 31.8 nm only, FITTED hypothesis (on-state saturation); total device 672 ohm at 3 V bounds it
